arStrings.szText:
{c_label}Cooldown:{/c_label} {c_resource}{Cooldown Time}{/c_resource} seconds
{c_label}Lucky Hit Chance: {/c}{c_resource}{Combat Effect Chance}%{/c}
{c_label}Passive:{/c} You and your allies emanate the Light, dealing {c_number}{payload:PULSING_DAMAGE}{/c} damage every {c_number}{SF_2}{/c} seconds to {c_number}{SF_5}{/c} random Nearby enemies. Attack Speed further increases this damage.

{c_label}Active:{/c} Unleash {c_number}{SF_35}{/c} pure bolts of light, dealing {c_number}{payload:ACTIVE_DAMAGE}{/c} Holy damage to the Closest enemy and chaining up to {c_number}[SF_10]{/c} additional enemies before returning to you. When your first bolt of light returns, Heal for {c_number}[SF_12*100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life {c_number}([Max(1,PlayerHealthMax() * {SF_12})]){/c}.
{c_important}Holy Light's{/c} passive now targets {c_number}{SF_25}{/c} additional enemies.
{c_important}Holy Light's{/c} active also {c_important}{u}Judges{/u}{/c} enemies and its Cooldown is reduced per rank.

{c_important}Holy Light's{/c} active chains {c_number}{SF_22}{/c} more times and {c_important}{u}Fortifies{/u}{/c} you and your allies for {c_number}[{SF_23} * 100|1%|]{/c} of their Maximum Life {c_number}([Max(1,PlayerHealthMax() * {SF_23})]){/c}.

{c_important}Holy Light's{/c} active now Stuns enemies for {c_number}{buffduration:CHAINED}{/c} seconds and deals {c_number}{payload:UPGRADE_C_EXPLOSION_PAYLOAD}{/c} damage in an area if the enemy dies during this effect.
{c_important}Holy Light Aura's{/c} passive now targets {c_number}{SF_55}{/c} additional enemies.
{c_important}Holy Light Aura's{/c} active bounces {c_number}[SF_54]{/c} additional time.
{c_important}Holy Light Aura{/c} gains {c_number}[SF_52 * 100 |%|]{/c} more bonus from potency.
{c_important}Holy Light Aura's{/c} deals {c_number}[{SF_48} * 100|%x|]{/c} increased damage against enemies affected by {c_important}{u}Judgement{/u}{/c}.
